mapper.select: UPDATE resumes SET analyze_status = 'PROCESSING', analysis_attempt_count = COALESCE(analysis_attempt_count, 0) + 1, analysis_deadline_at = #{deadline}, updated_by = #{userId}, trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{resumeId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND analysis_message_id = #{messageId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND COALESCE(analysis_attempt_count, 0) < #{maxAttempts} AND ( analyze_status = 'PENDING' OR ( analyze_status = 'PROCESSING' AND (analysis_deadline_at IS NULL OR analysis_deadline_at <= #{now}) ) ) RETURNING analysis_message_id AS message_id, id AS resume_id, user_id, resume_text, analysis_attempt_count AS attempt_count
